call_points.text: FY27 pre-sales guided at ₹1,800-2,000 Cr, with revenue and PAT growth of 55-60%.
Four more launches planned in FY27 with combined GDV of ₹3,500-4,000 Cr.
Appointed developer for Juhu commercial redevelopment with about ₹1,600 Cr GDV; construction to start next year after approvals.
Ongoing and upcoming pipeline: 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, aggregate GDV ₹17,500-18,000 Cr.
Net cash of ₹623 Cr at June 2026 (cash ₹776 Cr, debt ₹153 Cr).
Of the ₹550 Cr IPO earmark for Amalfi, Arcadian and Varun, ₹271 Cr deployed as of 30 June 2026.
Projected free cash flow of ₹3,245 Cr from completed and ongoing projects and ₹5,240 Cr from upcoming projects, total ₹8,485 Cr.
Sales and marketing spend is about 1% of pre-sales, expected to be offset by lower brokerage.
Management maintains FY27 pre-sales guidance of ₹1,800 to ₹2,000 crores.
Planned launches of six projects in FY27 with estimated GDV of ₹5,000 to ₹5,500 crores.
Q4 FY27 pre-sales stood at ₹462 crores, up 177% year-on-year.
Input costs rose by 7% and labor costs by 5%, translating to an approximate 1% increase in overall project cost.
Net cash as on March 31, 2026 stood at ₹697 crores.

operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 consolidated revenue stood at ₹307.5 Cr with PAT at ₹100.92 Cr.
FY26 pre-sales stood at ₹1,157 Cr, up 137% YoY.
Company maintains net debt-free position with industry-leading realisations of ₹69,000 per sq. ft.
Q4FY26 pre-sales stood at ₹462 Cr, up 177% YoY.
Average selling price was ₹86,000 per square foot in Q1FY27, with Aquaria launched at about ₹85,000 per square foot.
Sales strategy: about 20-30% of inventory sold at launch, with roughly 30% offloaded each year over a three-year project span.
Projected free cash flow: ₹3,245 Cr from completed and ongoing projects and ₹5,240 Cr from upcoming projects, total ₹8,485 Cr.
Promoters holding 87.87% voluntarily waived their right to receive the interim dividend of Re. 0.30 per share for FY27.

IPO proceeds of ₹792 Cr: ₹543.08 Cr utilised at Sep-2026, ₹248.92 Cr unutilised, of which ₹225 Cr in Indian Bank FDs at 6.00% maturing 04-Nov-2026 and ₹19.933 Cr in subsidiaries' dedicated current accounts.
Project-wise IPO spend at Sep-2026: Amalfi ₹57.852 Cr of ₹140 Cr, The Arcadian ₹186.163 Cr of ₹274 Cr, Varun ₹61.261 Cr of ₹136 Cr, GCP ₹182.294 Cr fully used.
Q2FY27 pre-sales stood at ₹470 Cr, up 83% YoY.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹307.5 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹95.58 Cr.
Sri Lotus Developers released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, guiding for FY27 pre-sales of ₹1,800–2,000 Cr.
Sri Lotus Developers reported FY26 pre-sales of ₹1,157 Cr (up 137% YoY) and revenue of ₹769 Cr (up 40% YoY), while guiding for FY27 pre-sales of ₹1,800-2,000 Cr.
Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited shared the Q4FY26 earnings call audio link on May 13, 2026, via its investor relations website and ccreservations.com.
Sri Lotus Developers reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹308 Cr and PAT of ₹101 Cr, with full-year pre-sales reaching ₹1,157 Cr.

On 4 August 2026 Sri Lotus Developers and Realty held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting pre-sales of ₹409 Cr (up 567% YoY) and collections of ₹150 Cr (up 115% YoY), and maintained FY27 pre-sales guidance of ₹1,800-2,000 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹268.58 Cr (+52.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹82.09 Cr (+77.9% YoY).
Sri Lotus Developers reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹269 Cr and net profit of ₹89 Cr, alongside pre-sales of ₹470 Cr.

On 16 October 2026 Sri Lotus filed CARE Ratings' monitoring agency report for Q2FY27: ₹543.08 Cr of the ₹792 Cr IPO proceeds utilised, ₹248.92 Cr unutilised, nil deviation from objects, and deployment deadline extended to March 31, 2027.
Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited made the audio recording of its Q2FY26 earnings call available on its website on October 16, 2026.
Sri Lotus Developers hosted its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call on October 16, 2026, reporting strong pre-sales and revenue growth.
